column3: Which files in this repository are written in Python? Bind the path to A.
Which definition kinds occur in this repository at all? Bind the kind to A.
What is the declared signature of "scip demo conn/connect()."? Bind it to A.
Which definitions carry a doc comment? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which file defines "scip ts util/retry()."? Bind the path to A.
Where does "scip demo render/render()." start? Bind the file to A and the first line to B.
Every distinct definition name in the repository. Bind the name to A.
Which imports bind a local alias? Bind the importing file to A and the alias to B.
Every definition whose span covers line 24 of src/core/store.rs. Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definition encloses line 18 of src/core/cache.rs most tightly? Bind its symbol id to A.
A stack frame points at src/core/cache.rs line 47 and carries no symbol name. What is transitively affected by the definition at that location? Bind each affected symbol id to A.
Which definitions cover line 24 of src/core/store.rs without being the tightest one there? Bind the symbol id to A.
What contains "scip ts app/App#render()." — directly or transitively, up to the file? Bind each container to A.
Which definitions are contained, directly or transitively, in the module "scip demo store/"? Bind the contained symbol id to A.
Which definitions does the file src/core/cache.rs contain, directly or transitively? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which containers of "scip demo store/Store#get()." are ancestors but not its direct parent? Bind the container to A.
column4: ?- within("scip demo store/Store#get().", A), !parent("scip demo store/Store#get().", A).

column3: Which definitions are visible outside the crate? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definitions are exported without stating public visibility themselves? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definitions are exported by a TypeScript export clause rather than by their own declaration? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definitions state a bounded visibility, or state none where the grammar offers the slot? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definitions have no visibility slot of their own and inherit export from an exported container? Bind the definition to A and that container to B.
Which definitions implement "scip demo store/Backend#", and on what provenance? Bind the implementor to A and the provenance to B.
Which implementation edges did the compiler confirm? Bind the implementor to A and the implemented symbol to B.
Which implementation edges rest on identifier text alone? Bind the implementor to A and the implemented symbol to B.
Which types implement the trait "scip demo store/Backend#"? Bind each implementor's NAME to A.
Some impl headers resolve to no implements row at all. Which implemented-type names, as written in an impl header, got no name-provenance implements row? Bind the written type name to A.
Which definition calls which, on either provenance? Bind the caller to A and the callee to B.
The same call graph, counting only compiler-resolved evidence. Bind the caller to A and the callee to B.
Which call edges exist only because identifier text matched? Bind the caller to A and the callee to B.
Where is "scip demo cache/hash()." called from? Bind the calling definition to A and the call site's line to B.
If "scip demo store/Store#put()." changed, what could be affected, transitively? Bind each affected symbol id to A.
The same blast radius for "scip demo store/Store#put()." but counting only compiler-resolved evidence. Bind each affected symbol id to A.
What does "scip demo lib/init()." call, directly or transitively? Bind each callee to A.
The same, for "scip demo lib/init().", counting only compiler-resolved evidence. Bind each callee to A.
Which definitions sit on a call cycle? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definitions sit on a call cycle the compiler confirms? Bind the symbol id to A.
What is reachable from "scip ts app/boot()." through calls? Bind each reachable symbol id to A.
Which call cycles exist only on name-matched edges? Bind each symbol on such a cycle to A.
Which callable definitions are called by nothing at all? Bind the symbol id to A.
The same question, counting only compiler-resolved calls. Bind the symbol id to A.
entrypoint INVERTS on name provenance. Which definitions does the exact form call an entrypoint while the name-tolerant form does not? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which exported definitions are never referenced outside the file that defines them? Bind the symbol id to A.
The same question, counting only compiler-resolved references. Bind the symbol id to A.
Which definitions does the exact form call a dead export while the name-tolerant form does not? Bind the symbol id to A.
Which files reference something defined in another file? Bind the referencing file to A and the defining file to B.
The same file-level dependency, counting only compiler-resolved references. Bind the referencing file to A and the defining file to B.
Which file-level dependencies rest on identifier text alone? Bind the referencing file to A and the defining file to B.
Conformance: no module under src/ui/ may import anything naming db. Report each violation, binding the file to A and the imported module to B.
Conformance: no module under src/db/ may import anything naming ui. Report each violation, binding the file to A and the imported module to B.
Conformance: nothing may reach for the old HTTP client. Report every import naming legacy_http, binding the file to A and the module to B.
Conformance at file granularity: no file under src/ui/ may depend on one under src/db/. Report each violation, binding the depending file to A and the depended-on file to B.
Which files import a module written as a crate-internal path? Bind the file to A and the module to B.
Which third-party packages does each file use, as the indexer names them? Bind the file to A and the package to B.
A file imports the module written as "react". Which package does the indexer attribute that to? Bind the file to A and the package name to B.
How many definitions does each file hold? Bind the file to A and the count to B. An aggregate groups by every variable bound outside it, so pick the outer literal with care.
column4: ?- file(A, _), B = count{ S : def(S, A, _, _) }.

column3: How many distinct definitions call "scip demo store/Store#get()."? Bind the count to A.
column4: ?- A = count{ C : calls(C, "scip demo store/Store#get().") }.

column3: How many definitions carry each kind? Bind the kind to A and the count to B.
column4: ?- def(_, _, A, _), B = count{ S : def(S, _, A, _) }.

column3: How many distinct definition NAMES does each file hold? Bind the file to A and the count to B.
column4: ?- file(A, _), B = count{ N : def(_, A, _, N) }.

column3: How many definitions does this repository hold in total? Bind the count to A. Note that count{} groups by every variable bound outside the aggregate, so binding the counted variable in the body as well returns one group per definition.
Which files hold more than three definitions? Bind the file to A.
column4: ?- file(A, _), N = count{ S : def(S, A, _, _) }, N > 3.

column3: How many exported definitions does each file hold? Bind the file to A and the count to B.
column4: ?- file(A, _), B = count{ S : def(S, A, _, _), exported(S) }.
